entries.metric: EV share of new passenger vehicle sales, global
entries.quote: The EV share of global new passenger vehicle sales jumps to 33% in 2027, from 17.8% in 2023.
entries.note: Base-year value as stated in the edition. Not a projection.

notes: The release calls the Economic Transition Scenario 'BNEF's base case scenario'. Net Zero Scenario requires 100% electrification of the fleet by 2050 versus 69% in the base case (fleet figures, not captured). No price parity year and no 2030 passenger figure in the public release.
